# Degree of a Vertex in a Directed Graph

#### Course: DSA with C++

## Degree of a Vertex in a Directed Graph

In a directed graph, the degree of a vertex is divided into two types:

- Indegree: The number of incoming edges to a vertex.
- Outdegree: The number of outgoing edges from a vertex.

![A Directed Graph](data:image/png;base64,)

| Vertex | Indegree | Outdegree |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | 1 | 1 |
| 2 | 1 | 1 |
| 3 | 1 | 2 |
| 4 | 1 | 0 |
| 5 | 0 | 0 |
